notes.note: Coverage: every verse 30:1-43 belongs to an event. Nothing is left out.

The births of Gen 29:31-30:24 cannot be placed with certainty. The text gives no intervals, and Jacob's 14 years of service (29:20, 29:30; Gen 31:41) leave only about 4 years between Judah (c. 1919 BCE) and Joseph (c. 1915 BCE) for eight more births. I therefore run the Bilhah and Zilpah threads in parallel from Judah's birth (about 10 months between births in each thread) and anchor Leah's later sons on the mandrake night. Joseph's birth is anchored separately on the START of the second seven years (6 y 3 m offset, so he is born about when the 14 years end, 30:25). With margins of one year or more the chains are compatible. The tradition that all the sons but Benjamin were born within the seven years (Seder Olam) is not in the packet and I did not use it.
